about.text: A black, highly acidic dairy product of Iran, Afghanistan and Central Asia, made by boiling down the sour whey left from making kashk, or qurut, until it thickens, then drying it until brittle.

links.name: Wikipedia: Qaraqorut (citing Walker, Milk – Beyond the Dairy, 1999)

facts.v: The liquid drained from doogh or kashk, boiled until the curd forms, then dried

sources.text: The kashk and doogh whey, and the names, from these.
